capabilities: List notes sharing tags with the current note
Group notes by exact shared tag sets
Sort notes within groups by name or date
Show folder path and first-paragraph summary
Color tags with stable per-name colors
disambiguation: Not a tag-to-tag graph; it lists notes that share tags with the current note in a sidebar panel.
extras: Fully local with no network requests; works on desktop and mobile; requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; installable via BRAT or manual copy.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see which other notes share tags with the note you are currently viewing.

relations.evidence: hover a note to preview it when the core Page preview plugin is enabled

summary: Right sidebar panel that lists notes sharing tags with the current note, grouped by the exact set of shared tags.
